summary: iter122 — Backend fix in /app/backend/routers/blocks.py verified: owner CAN now block/hide a payment tracker from a coach/staff collaborator. 6/6 backend pytest cases pass (owner list includes coach with team_access=true & blocked=false, block returns {blocked:true}, coach's GET /api/team/payments excludes blocked tracker, coach's GET /api/team/payments/{id} returns 403, unblock restores visibility, family regression intact). BUT the frontend fix is INCOMPLETE: the lock icon (SheetAccessButton) is gated by useCanManageAccess() which only counts household `members` with team_access=true and IGNORES `collaborators` (coaches/staff). On the seeded demo hub the only granted user is the coach (collaborator) — so canManage=false and the lock icon never renders on Team → Payments even though the backend now supports blocking. User cannot reach the 'Who can view this?' modal via the UI in the exact scenario the bug is meant to fix.

ui_bugs.issue: Lock icon on Team → Payments (and Paperwork, Sign-ups) does NOT render when the only other granted user is a coach/staff collaborator. Hook counts `r.data.members.filter(m => !m.is_owner && m.team_access)` but coaches live in `r.data.collaborators`. Result: 'Who can view this?' modal is unreachable in exactly the scenario the backend fix targets. Reference: /app/frontend/src/hooks/useCanManageAccess.ts:15-19

integration_issues.flow: Owner hides Coach Gift tracker from coach
integration_issues.issue: Backend /api/team/blocks endpoints work perfectly (verified via pytest), but SheetAccessButton is never mounted for the owner unless a family household member has team_access=true. Fix: include collaborators in the 'others' count inside useCanManageAccess (mirror the backend blocks.py change).

action_items: Update /app/frontend/src/hooks/useCanManageAccess.ts to also count coach/staff collaborators. The /api/team-access response includes a `collaborators` array (each is a granted user separate from `members`); add its length to `others`, e.g. `const collabs = (r.data as any).collaborators?.length || 0; setCanManage(!!r.data.is_owner && (others + collabs) > 0);`. After fix, re-verify by opening Team → Payments as demo@cheerplanner.app and tapping the lock icon — coach.casey should appear with a Can-view/Hidden toggle.
Consider surfacing the SheetAccessButton also on the payment DETAIL screen (/team/payment.tsx) for discoverability.

SheetAccessButton.tsx correctly disables the toggle when !m.team_access; coaches have team_access=true so they render as tappable.
useCanManageAccess only inspects members[] and ignores collaborators[] — this is the parallel frontend bug matching what was fixed on the backend.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (backend): blocks.py was previously restricting members and allowed-block sets to household.member_user_ids. Coaches/staff are stored separately in household.team_hub_member_user_ids and are not part of member_user_ids, so GET returned an empty list and PUT rejected with 404. FIXED by unioning both id sets in both GET and PUT (blocks.py L34-35 and L58). ROOT CAUSE (frontend, still open): useCanManageAccess.ts only counts members[] with team_access=true from /api/team-access and ignores the parallel collaborators[] array where coaches live, so the lock icon is hidden in the exact scenario the backend fix enables. REPRODUCTION: Log in as demo@cheerplanner.app, POST a payment tracker, open /team/payments — no lock icon renders even though /api/team-access returns collaborators:[coach.casey]. MITIGATION: See action_items — include collaborators length in the canManage decision.
